# Introduction

Brenna is an aggressive miniboss found in the Black Forest inside Smouldering Tombs as well as during the "She's hot on your tail!" event. She is a burning Skeleton with charcoal black bones and fire aspects wielding a fiery version of Krom.
The Swedish word "bränna", with similar pronunciation, means "to burn".

### Drops

• Item: Hildir's brass chest | 0 Star: 1

• Item: Brenna trophy | 0 Star: 100%

### Sword

A basic sword slash that hits in a 1.8-meter 90-degree horizontal arc (60 Slash and 20 Fire damage). It can be used every 3 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player.

### Fire nova

Stabs her sword into the ground, creating a 3-meter radius circular explosion (75 Fire damage). This attack can be used every 10 seconds when a player is in the attack's range.

Categorias: Creatures, Minibosses
